# spaceman skill

Skill catalog: list, show and publish.

Aliases: `skills`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman skill get`](#spaceman-skill-get) | A skill with its versions and files |
| [`spaceman skill list`](#spaceman-skill-list) | The skill catalog |
| [`spaceman skill publish`](#spaceman-skill-publish) | Publish the skill's draft |

## spaceman skill get

A skill with its versions and files.

```sh
spaceman skill get <skill> [flags]
```

API: `get-skill` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman skill list

The skill catalog.

```sh
spaceman skill list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-skills` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman skill publish

Publish the skill's draft.

```sh
spaceman skill publish <skill> [flags]
```

API: `get-skill`, `publish-skill` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
